verdict.rationale: Latham has a dedicated Trademark Litigation practice page. It states the team prosecutes trademark applications (registration), maintains and polices trademark portfolios worldwide (enforcement), and drafts trademark licenses, co-existence and settlement agreements. The IP Litigation page also lists trademark cases. Missing for 10: any documented trademark clearance or search work, and independent corroboration of the prosecution and portfolio side beyond first-party claims.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: We bring exceptional experience prosecuting trademark applications and maintaining and policing trademark portfolios throughout the world.
the copyright, trademark, and trade secrets cases that reshape industries.
